name: brwalsh
install:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cursor/skills" "$HOME/.agents/skills"
if ! command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y rsync; fi
rm -rf /tmp/cursor-user-skills
gh repo clone BriWalsh/cursor-user-skills /tmp/cursor-user-skills || git clone https://github.com/BriWalsh/cursor-user-skills.git /tmp/cursor-user-skills
rsync -a --exclude '.git' --exclude 'README.md' /tmp/cursor-user-skills/ "$HOME/.cursor/skills/"
rsync -a --exclude '.git' --exclude 'README.md' /tmp/cursor-user-skills/ "$HOME/.agents/skills/"
